correctness.rationale: Every cycle in the clique bouquet lies within one complete block, so global acyclic orientations are exactly independent transitive block tournaments. A block has a_i! hub-sink and a_i a_i! peripheral-sink orientations. Product C∏(1+a_i z) counts peripheral sinks and the unique all-hub case is corrected from 1 to z, yielding C[∏(1+a_i z)+z−1]. Newton’s inequalities prove strict log-concavity of coefficients (1+e1,e2,...,er), including the modified first inequality using e1>=r. For r=3, discriminant (ab+ac+bc)^2−4abc(1+a+b+c) exactly characterizes real nonzero roots. Independently expanded ∆(a,5,6)=a²−780a+900: it is nonnegative for positive integers a=1 or a>=779. With b=c=k, ∆=k²[k²−4a(k+1)]. Odd homogeneous r have derivative >0 and only the zero real root; even r have exactly one extra negative root by convexity. Full finite exact source checker inspects small graph orientations and many discriminants but unrestricted proof rests on the orientation factorization.
